name: Claude Sessions
author: Mike
description: Live status of every coding-agent session on this machine (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and more): working, waiting on you, or your turn.

barWidget.description: One icon that shows whether your coding agents are working or need you, and a panel listing every session. Pick one to jump to its window.

schema.label: Notify when a session needs you
schema.description: Unfocused notifies only when that session's window isn't the one you're looking at.
